results.title: Competing TDSO skeletal-editing pathways and energy profile
results.response:
Plan & checks (executed)
- Parsed **TS.png** to identify the reacting scaffold (NH pyrazole with two ring nitrogens) and the shown outcome (“N‑alkyl pyrazole”).
- Applied the requested substituent simplifications (α-to-sulfur ring carbon = Me; other ring substituents = H; N‑alkyl = Me).
- Built **two neutral tautomeric substrates** (N–H on either ring N) and the **two corresponding N‑methyl products** (regioisomers).
- Sanity-checked products/substrates by converting XYZ → SMILES and by inspecting N-atom neighbor lists to confirm which N bears H vs Me.

Key inference/assumption (from TS.png)
- TS.png depicts a sulfur-containing auxiliary in the substrate but **not** in the product drawing (“N‑alkyl pyrazole”), so the **product geometries were built without the S-containing group**.

Files written (requested XYZ + report)
- `ts-study/structures/pathway_A_substrate.xyz`
- `ts-study/structures/pathway_A_product.xyz`
- `ts-study/structures/pathway_B_substrate.xyz`
- `ts-study/structures/pathway_B_product.xyz`
- `ts-study/mechanistic_report.txt`
